prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash depicts a busy hospital corridor scene. On the left, a nurse in blue scrubs stands holding a clipboard while looking at a patient on a gurney. The patient, an elderly woman in a white gown, lies still with her eyes closed. Next to the gurney, a young boy in a striped shirt holds the woman's hand tightly. In the center, a doctor in a white coat points toward a digital wall clock showing three o'clock. Beside the doctor, a janitor pushes a yellow mop bucket across the tiled floor. A brown dog sits calmly next to the janitor, wearing a service vest. On the right, two visitors sit on a wooden bench; one wears a green jacket and the other wears a floral dress. The person in the green jacket hands a tissue to the person in the floral dress. Behind them, a potted fern stands tall in a ceramic pot. Above the group, a fluorescent light fixture hangs from the ceiling. Near the entrance, a security guard in a dark uniform looks at a monitor screen. A wheelchair rests empty against the far wall. A water dispenser stands near the corner with a plastic cup on top. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no emergency exit sign displayed on the walls.
